children: ARABIAN DRILLING- ANNOUNCES SIGNING OF A FIVE-YEAR CONTRACT FOR 8 LAND RIGS, FOR GAS LSTK OPERATIONS
ARABIAN DRILLING - CONTRACT ADDS ABOUT SAR 2 BILLION TO ARABIAN DRILLING BACKLOG
ARABIAN DRILLING-CONTRACT VALUE	APPROXIMATELY SAR 2 BILLION.
ARABIAN DRILLING: RIGS WILL BE REDEPLOYED FROM THE EXISTING AVAILABLE LAND RIG FLEET AND BRING COMPANY'S TOTAL BACKLOG TO APPROXIMATELY SAR 16 BILLION
ARABIAN DRILLING-CONTRACT IS EXPECTED TO CONTRIBUTE TO COMPANY'S REVENUES STARTING FROM FOURTH QUARTER OF 2026
